# The Dew Pond

*Roland's best summer was spent camped by a dew pond on the downs. He wants to know if it is still there, the bees around it cleared, and Joan told that he asked, though he would never tell her himself.*

## Objectives

1. Reach the dew pond in [The Thyme Banks](../maps/thyme_banks.md)
2. Defeat 30 [Wild Bee](../monsters/wild_bee.md) in [The Thyme Banks](../maps/thyme_banks.md)
3. Talk to [Joan](../npcs/joan.md)

## Rewards

- 3,000 EXP
- 520 mesos
- [Orange Potion](../items/orange_potion.md) x10
- +20 standing with Selsior
- +150 standing with [Roland](../npcs/roland.md)
